name: characterizing FlowCell aquatic sites
from: A candidate FlowCell test/deployment site or site class is proposed.
to: A bounded hydraulic, sediment, scour, ice, ecological, AIS/decontamination, navigation, jurisdiction, and recovery envelope exists, or a precise data-acquisition gap is stated.
